title: Dad's Coming-Home Welcome Rhythm | Family Song for Kids
format: inclusive family anticipation story-song with child-led greeting choices

music.sound_policy: Clock, paper, keys, door, footsteps and household percussion are synchronized effects and never spoken as imitation words.

creative_intent: Turn waiting for a parent into a warm, inclusive musical story: the child notices time and changing light, chooses a comfortable greeting, welcomes Dad without forced affection, and shares a joyful home rhythm.
visual_system: premium stop-motion-inspired layered paper-and-fabric apartment sets with tactile wool, stitched cushions, cut-paper light shapes and one consistent family

motion_language.easing_family: soft cubic ease with small playful landings
motion_language.transition_family: match cuts through the round clock, sun disc and doorway arch
motion_language.motion_intensity: one hero action per scene, support below half amplitude, ambient light drift only
motion_language.hold_discipline: at least one full beat of visual rest after each greeting action

character_lock.child: Mina, 5-year-old South Asian-Australian girl, dark wavy bob, mustard star hairclip, teal dungarees over a coral shirt, striped socks
character_lock.dad: Arun, South Asian-Australian father, short dark curls, neat beard, navy rain jacket over a rust jumper, canvas work bag
character_lock.home: cosy teal, coral and honey apartment living room with rounded doorway, low round clock, mustard sofa, stitched cloud cushions and a broad window

scenes.visual_action: Mina looks from the round picture clock to warm afternoon light crossing the window seat. A small family-photo card shows Dad, while a blank folded welcome card waits beside coloured pencils.
scenes.musical_treatment: Soft kalimba and brushed heartbeat pulse; the melody rises with each glance from clock to window.
lyric_intent: Golden light is sliding; home-time's drawing near.
Mina checks the picture clock: Dad will soon be here.
lyrics: Golden light slides through the room.
Mina checks the picture clock.
Card and colours wait for Dad.
scenes.camera: slow curved push from clock to Mina and the window

scenes.visual_action: Mina clears the doorway path, places Dad's indoor slippers neatly and finishes a bright drawing of their home. The sky outside shifts from gold toward peach.
scenes.musical_treatment: A tidy two-beat bass pattern joins kalimba; paper and slipper actions land on alternating beats.
lyric_intent: Clear a little pathway; make a cosy place.
Fold a happy picture with a bright familiar face.
lyrics: Clear the path and make some room.
Two soft slippers wait together.
Mina's bright home picture is ready.
scenes.camera: gentle side follow ending on the finished drawing

scenes.visual_action: Three large picture cards offer a wave, a high-five and sharing the drawing. Mina considers them, chooses the wave card and places it on the welcome stand; all choices remain visibly acceptable.
scenes.musical_treatment: Three distinct woodblock-and-bell motifs present the options, followed by a confident resolving chord when Mina chooses.
lyric_intent: Wave, high-five, or share your art—choose what feels just right.
Every welcome can be warm; Mina picks tonight.
lyrics: Wave, high-five, or share your art.
Every welcome choice can feel right.
Mina chooses one friendly wave.
scenes.camera: stable overhead choice tableau, then eased tilt to Mina's smile

scenes.visual_action: The room turns softly peach-blue. A key shadow reaches the frosted door panel, the handle moves once, and Mina waits on her floor star with her drawing held safely at her side.
scenes.musical_treatment: Percussion thins to a held bass note and small clock pulse; harmony tightens until the handle moves.
lyric_intent: Evening paints the window; footsteps cross the hall.
Mina finds her waiting star and hears the softest call.
lyrics: Peach light turns to evening blue.
One key shadow crosses the door.
Mina waits calmly on her star.
scenes.camera: locked doorway composition with a very slow suspense push

scenes.visual_action: Dad opens the door, sets down his bag and pauses at Mina's height. Mina initiates her chosen broad wave; Dad mirrors it with a delighted smile before she offers the drawing.
scenes.musical_treatment: Harmony opens into warm strings and ukulele; the two waves land as a musical question and answer.
lyric_intent: Door swings wide—Dad is home; he stops and smiles hello.
Mina leads her chosen wave, and Dad joins in the flow.
lyrics: Dad comes in and sets down his bag.
Mina starts her chosen wave.
Dad smiles and waves back slowly.
scenes.camera: medium doorway two-shot with a gentle settle after the mirrored wave

scenes.visual_action: Mina taps a small hand drum, Dad pats two stitched sofa cushions, and they copy a simple three-beat home rhythm while the drawing stands between them.
scenes.musical_treatment: Full child-friendly groove: hand drum answers two low cushion beats, then voices trade one short melodic phrase.
lyric_intent: One beat from Mina, two beats from Dad.
Copy our home rhythm—gentle, bright and glad.
lyrics: Mina plays one gentle drum beat.
Dad answers with two cushion pats.
Listen, copy, then take your turn.
scenes.camera: low triangular composition linking hands, drawing and smiling faces

scenes.emotion: joyful belonging with a calm resolve
scenes.visual_action: Mina and Dad display the drawing on the family wall, then sit side by side under the now-blue evening window. Their final wave faces the viewer as the room glows honey-gold.
scenes.musical_treatment: The full welcome motif returns with kalimba, ukulele, hand drum and warm harmony, then resolves into a long soft chord.
lyric_intent: Different ways to welcome, every heart can choose.
Home is time together in our cosy evening blues.
lyrics: Clip the picture on the wall.
Different welcomes warm us all.
Wave together, soft and slow.
scenes.camera: slow pullback to the complete room, holding the final viewer wave

quality_gates: Mina, Dad and the apartment remain visually consistent in every scene.
No physical affection is required; Mina initiates the visible greeting and Dad respects her choice.
Every lyric and effect remains inside the scene that visibly supports it.
Changing window light and the round clock make the passage of time understandable.
No clock, key, door, footstep or percussion sound is spoken as an imitation word.
The score audibly changes through anticipation, preparation, choice, suspense, relief, play and resolve.
Every story scene is five four-beat bars (12.5 seconds) and below the 14-second ceiling.
Final output includes visual, transition, lyric-emotion-sync and full-decode evidence.
